results.question: How many customers are there? Return one column named count.
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM customers;

results.question: What is the sum of total_amount across all orders? Return one column named total.
results.sql:
SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total
FROM orders;

results.question: List the three most expensive products, returning name and price, sorted by price descending and name ascending.
results.sql:
SELECT name, price
FROM products
ORDER BY price DESC, name ASC
LIMIT 3;
